decisions.reason: Turnaround management software has kept a dedicated page in both years and sits at the core of the firm's data-driven airport strategy, so its prospects remain promising and holding this software option costs little.
Moving from a mention to its own page signals growing commitment, and as a low-cost software module it remains a valuable option while airside connectivity demand resolves.
The billing software gained its own page, showing the firm is investing further, though it lies somewhat further from the core airside offering, so its value is a little less certain.
Equipment monitoring software complements the firm's installed hardware and maintenance services, and its promotion to its own page suggests positive early signals worth keeping open.
